labels.5: Must-have / would pay a premium now

_note: 6 stylistically varied, domain-independent anchor sets capturing different ways people express adoption / willingness-to-pay intent. Generic by design so they apply to any product concept.

sets.1: I would never use this; it has no value for me.
sets.2: I probably wouldn't use this; it doesn't seem worth it.
sets.3: I'm not sure; I might try it but I have no strong feelings either way.
sets.4: I would likely use this; it seems genuinely useful to me.
sets.5: I would absolutely use this and happily pay for it right away.

sets.1: This solves no problem I actually have.
sets.2: This is a minor convenience at best, not worth switching for.
sets.3: This could be handy once in a while, but I'd have to see.
sets.4: This would clearly save me real time and effort.
sets.5: This would transform how I work; I need it now.
